blocks.html: RLC Residences premium condominium development Mantawi Residences in Mandaue City, Cebu has reached another construction milestone through the ceremonial concrete pouring for its Tower 1 held in March 2026.

Located along Ouano Avenue, a prime spot with a multitude of infrastructure and development plans in the pipeline, Mantawi Residences is well on its way to make true its promise of becoming Cebu’s Frontier of Progress.

“Today, we have just witnessed another ceremonial and technical milestone that will mark the official commencement of the many structural construction phases of Mantawi Residences, another project of RLC Residences aimed at bringing together carefully crafted living spaces and premium amenities, in a central address,” said Engr. Emmanuel Arce, RLC Residences Head of Constructions 1 & 2 during the event.

Present during the ceremony were RLC Residences executives, led by Senior Vice President & Business Unit General Manager Teddy V. Bernas, and officials from its construction partner Terp Asia Construction Corporation.

blocks.cap: From left to right: RLC Residences Head of Marketing Dan Carlo Torres, RLC Residences Head of Business Development Katrina Tordilla, RLC Residences Head of Corporate Project Procurement Engr. Rodanil de Silva, RLC Residences Head of Constructions 1&2 Engr. Emmanuel Arce, RLC Residences Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager Teddy V. Bernas, Terp Asia Construction Corporation Chairman Engr. Adolfo Escalona, Terp Asia Construction Corporation Project Director Ryan Escalona, RLC Residences Head of Planning and Design Ar. Conrad Erfe, and RLC Residences Overall Head of Sales Denise Lyttle-Lao.

blocks.html: Arce expressed confidence that through the strategic location of this development, Mantawi Residences can deliver to its future residents a home that connects them to abundant opportunities and where they can truly live their best life. Homebuyers can look forward to the development’s spacious living spaces and well-designed amenities curated for home and investment seekers in Cebu and beyond.
“We value the commitment of our partners, who, for a long period of time, see to it that everything will be carried out as planned,” Arce said.
Mantawi Residences is targeted to be completed by February 2031.
